title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_description:
Can you guess which egg has the dragon inside? Pick your answer before the reveal! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #Quiz

scenes.narration: One of these eggs has a dragon inside — but which one?!
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg right now! Three... two... one!
The red egg cracks open and... it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The blue egg pops open and... it's a tiny frog! Ribbit!
And the golden egg — BOOM — out comes a baby dragon! You got it right!
Nice work! Level 2 is coming tomorrow — can you beat it?
